sanitization: No tenant IDs, project or Agent Stream IDs, endpoints, credentials, trace content, prompts, or application data are recorded.

environment.package: temporary standalone copy of the skill directory

checks.agent_skills_frontmatter: All 170 repository skills passed the frontmatter, local resource link, and agents/openai.yaml audit.
checks.feature_and_action_contract: The skill validator accepted 49 feature rows, 55 object action rows, and 22 API reference groups.
checks.standalone_copy: The copied skill validated and generated first-trace, Agent Control create, and SaaS access-token verification plans from an unrelated working directory.
checks.repo_readiness: The initial repository readiness run exposed a stale Agent Observability feature-contract snapshot; the manifest hash was refreshed to match the reviewed current matrix contract and the final repository audits passed.

limitations: No live Splunk Agent Observability project or Agent Stream was available for synthetic trace readback.
Agent Control policy creation, stream binding, allow/deny runtime behavior, and tenant cleanup were not tested.
This result validates skill packaging and its offline coverage/planning contract only; it does not prove SaaS feature behavior.
runs.cleanup: The temporary standalone copy was removed automatically. No tenant or cloud resources were changed.

environment.runtime: bounded Kubernetes Jobs with protected-token SecretRef

checks.authenticated_api: AO project API accepted the replacement INGEST plus API token; project and Agent Stream create/read succeeded.
checks.telemetry: Synthetic-only SDK Job completed; AO query returned the validation trace, tool span, and marked session in the exact disposable Agent Stream. The SDK also generated an additional session.
checks.control_management: Created a global list evaluator control, cloned and bound it to the disposable Agent Stream, read its policy and binding through the tenant Agent Control API, and changed only its clone.
checks.runtime: Agent Control SDK 8.5.0 in isovalent-demo allowed the safe input, denied the marker input with ControlViolationError, and executed the protected function only for the safe input.
checks.control_telemetry: AO returned two control spans from an earlier unmatched policy attempt. The later successful deny check was independently observed at the Kubernetes runtime; a corresponding deny span was not verified.
checks.configuration_corrections: splunk-ao 0.4.0 rejected SaaS O11y and standalone API variables together. The tool input was wrapped, so selector input with contains matched where selector * with exact did not.

limitations: The 55 object/action families and policy dimensions are documentation-mapped, not all live-created. SaaS-inapplicable and unavailable external-provider objects were not exercised.
The passing allow/deny runtime check and the ingested control spans came from separate attempts; a single trace showing the final deny action was not verified.
Agent Control SDK init registered a unique agent record with zero steps and zero evaluators. The tenant OpenAPI exposes no delete-agent action, and that record still existed after project deletion.
Deactivation of the newly provisioned Splunk Observability access token was not verified.
runs.cleanup: Exact binding detach returned deleted=true; the control clone and global control were deleted and returned 404 on readback. Synthetic span, trace, and session searches returned zero before the Agent Stream and project were deleted; both returned 404 afterward. Validation Jobs, ConfigMaps, and the dedicated Secret were removed and Kubernetes readback found none. A control-free Agent Control registration remains and requires a supported vendor or tenant-admin removal path.
